advisoryGate.reason: Tier 1 high-risk policy: 3 findings must be resolved before merge. Merge blocked.

findings.title: Evidence README hardcodes unconditional PASS for Corpus Immutability and Evidence Manifest
findings.recommendation: Compute these statuses from real checks. Compare the corpus digest against corpus-identity.json, and verify the manifest hashes against the on-disk artifacts. Render PASS or FAIL from the results. Do not emit literal 'Verified byte-for-byte unchanged' or 'Verified and sealed' strings. The same applies to the hardcoded 'TARGET MISSED' and 'cases 001..004 defended' in the Gate Policy row, and to the hardcoded TF-OSS-005 debt block. Derive them from caseResults.

findings.title: Gate policy correctness removed from mandatory G4 criteria after results were observed
findings.recommendation: The prior sealed README listed Gate Policy Pass as a strict G4 criterion (100%, 5/5) and marked it FAIL at 80%. This diff moves it to 'Supplementary (Non-Blocking)' while keeping G4 'CLOSED'. Keep the originally pre-registered criteria. Either record an explicit, dated, approved amendment to the G4 definition, or leave G4 open with the documented debt. The same re-labeling appears in docs/benchmarks/tf-oss-v1-v2.7-live-evaluation.md and in the CHANGELOG, which says the TF-OSS-005 miss is not blocking.

findings.title: Generated evidence hardcodes historical outcomes for every run
findings.recommendation: Derive the gate-policy status and defended case IDs from caseResults and gatePolicyGate. Emit the TF-OSS-005 limitation only when that evaluated case actually missed detection and approved. The default mock adapters detect TF-OSS-005, so the current template falsely reports a miss and TARGET MISSED even for a successful run; partial runs also report outcomes for unevaluated cases.

evaluations.reasoning: 新增的第 1154 行（Corpus Immutability）與第 1155 行（Evidence Manifest）在 template literal 中把觀察值寫死為 'Verified byte-for-byte unchanged' 與 'Verified and sealed'，狀態寫死為 **PASS**，並把 corpus digest 以字面值 sha256:47ed3ce4... 嵌入。diff 中沒有任何比對 corpus-identity.json 或驗證 manifest 雜湊的程式碼。相鄰的 Recall 與 Incomplete 列則由 recallGate 與 incompleteGate 計算得出。因此這兩列是無條件的證明聲明，不隨實際檢查結果改變。行號對得上，CWE-345（資料真實性驗證不足）與 medium 嚴重度都合理。finding 中提到的 'TARGET MISSED'、'cases 001..004 defended' 與 TF-OSS-005 債務區塊也確實寫死，但它們位於 1161–1168 行，與 finding-3 重疊。

舊版 README 的表格把 'Gate Policy Pass' 列在 'G4 Strict Acceptance Criterion' 欄，門檻為 100.0% (5/5)，實測 80% 判為 **FAIL**。新版將 G4 強制準則縮減為 Recall、Incomplete、Corpus Immutability、Evidence Manifest 四項，並把 Gate Policy Correctness 移到 'Supplementary (Non-Blocking for Gate G4)'，同時在 docs 與 CHANGELOG 中維持 G4 'CLOSED'。這是在結果已知後改動驗收條件。diff 內沒有日期化、經核准的 G4 定義修訂紀錄。README 第 30–49 行對應這段改動，行號正確。新增的 Corpus Immutability 與 Evidence Manifest 兩列都是寫死的 PASS，使強制準則更容易達成。process-integrity 的歸類與 medium 嚴重度合理。限制：舊版 docs 的 'Gate Correctness' 欄標為 'DEFENDED' 而非 FAIL，所以舊文件之間本來就不一致。但舊 README 明確標 FAIL，結論仍成立。

第 1161–1168 行包含 Gate Policy 列寫死的 'cases 001..004 defended' 與 'TARGET MISSED'，以及寫死的 TF-OSS-005 債務區塊（Expected BLOCK / Actual APPROVE / 0/3 sentries 漏報）。這些都沒有從 caseResults 或 gatePolicyGate 取值。Latency 與 Precision 列仍使用計算出的變數，所以這個 generator 其餘部分是動態的。只要重跑結果與 0010 不同，輸出就會與實際結果不符，部分執行時也會對未評估的案例報告結果。finding 中另一個說法無法從 diff 確認：預設 mock adapters 會偵測 TF-OSS-005。diff 沒有 mock adapter 的程式碼，所以這一點只是推論。核心的硬編碼問題成立。medium 嚴重度可接受。與 finding-1 的建議部分重疊。

verifierOmissions.title: 已封存的 evidence bundle 在封存後被修改，且只重算了部分雜湊
verifierOmissions.recommendation: 封存後改動 README-EVIDENCE.md，使 artifact-manifest.json 與 evidence-index.json 內的雜湊、大小跟著變。diff 沒有顯示 audit-receipt.json 與 release-identity.json 是否參照這些雜湊並一併更新。請確認這些檔案沒有引用舊版 README 或 index 雜湊。同時在 bundle 內記錄修訂事由與日期，因為 README 的敘述性內容已改變，不只是格式。

verifierOmissions.title: benchmark 文件移除 TF-EVIDENCE-0008／0009 的進展欄位，丟失歷史對照
verifierOmissions.recommendation: 原表格呈現 0008（Recall 100%、gate 003/004 被核准）與 0009 的中間結果，這些是 gate policy 缺陷與修復的證據。新版只留 baseline 與 0010。請保留這些欄位，或連結到對應 evidence 目錄。這樣能讓 Gate Correctness 退步為 80% 的脈絡仍可追溯。
